This Slow Interview is a little different from others because of the uniqueness of the guest.
Meet a monk in this episode of The Slow Interview.
Gaur Gopal Das Ji is a monk, a storyteller, a life coach and an author. In this interview he will unfold deeper aspects of life, happiness and relationship.
ISKCON Mumbai's Gaur Gopal Das is loved and followed by millions for his mindful and motivational speeches. His life is an inspiration for many. He authored a book – Life’s Amazing Secrets, which is a national bestseller, sold over 100,000 copies.
